name: 蜡笔手绘
author: TO DO
description: 手绘蜡笔 / 油画棒简笔画：蜡质笔触、白纸留白、稚拙歪扭的线条，像手绘动画短片的一帧。用中文描述画面即可。

inputs.label: 画面内容
inputs.placeholder: 例如：一个穿西装的男人站在挂满彩色衬衫的服装店里

options.label: 缤纷蜡笔
options.prompt: bright saturated oil pastel colors (magenta, lime green, orange, cobalt blue, violet, yellow) used boldly side by side

options.label: 铅笔+点彩
options.prompt: mostly a loose graphite pencil sketch in grey hatching, with only a few bold crayon color accents (such as turquoise, cobalt blue and red) on key elements

options.label: 暖色调
options.prompt: a warm crayon palette of orange, ochre, brick red, golden yellow and brown, with small touches of dark green

options.label: 冷色调
options.prompt: a cool crayon palette of cobalt blue, turquoise, teal, leaf green and violet, with small touches of warm skin tones

options.label: 简笔涂鸦
options.prompt: Extremely simple doodle drawing with very few strokes, basic childlike shapes, minimal detail, like a quick crayon sketch by a child

options.label: 童趣插画
options.prompt: Naive picture-book illustration with simplified shapes, wobbly hand-drawn outlines and charmingly imperfect proportions

options.label: 饱满涂色
options.prompt: Densely colored oil pastel drawing, thick layered wax strokes covering most of the shapes, energetic scribbled texture

options.label: 白纸留白
options.prompt: Drawn on plain white drawing paper with lots of uncolored paper showing and a subtle paper grain

options.label: 满幅场景
options.prompt: The whole frame is filled with a crayon-colored scene and background, loosely scribbled right up to the edges

options.label: 纯白底
options.prompt: A single isolated subject on a pure flat white background, no background strokes, no scenery, no paper texture

prompt.template: Hand-drawn crayon and oil pastel illustration of {{subject}}. {{detail}}. Colors: {{palette}}. Visible waxy crayon strokes with directional hatching, rough broken edges where the wax skips over the paper tooth, uneven hand pressure, colors scribbled and layered rather than smoothly blended, slightly wobbly outlines, like a single frame from a hand-drawn crayon animation short film. Flat 2D artwork viewed straight on, no photographic lighting, no digital smoothness. {{background}}.
avoid: crayons or pencils visible in the picture
